nodes.name: OpenClaw triage (HTTP bridge)
nodes.notes: POSTs the email to the host bridge (127.0.0.1:8088) which runs the fitness-triage OpenClaw skill, creates the Gmail DRAFT (IMAP append, never sends) and the Monday card, and returns the routing-decision JSON. Reachable because the container uses --network host.
